hooks.command: bash -lc 'S="$HOME/.grok/hard-allow/session.json"; E="$HOME/.grok/hard-allow/active.env"; if [ -f "$S" ]; then node "$HOME/.grok/hard-allow/ceremony.mjs" --check >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[HARD ALLOW] session active (token armed)" || echo "[HARD ALLOW] session file expired — run grok --hard-allow"; fi; if [ -n "${SECOPS_HARD_ALLOW_TOKEN:-}" ] || [ "${GROK_HARD_ALLOW_ACTIVE:-}" = "1" ]; then echo "[HARD ALLOW] env armed GROK_HARD_ALLOW_ACTIVE=${GROK_HARD_ALLOW_ACTIVE:-0}"; fi'
